paper.title: Middo: Model-Informed Dynamic Data Optimization for Enhanced LLM Fine-Tuning via Closed-Loop Learning
paper.central_claim: 以loss、embedding稀疏度与self-alignment动态诊断和重写SFT数据，在近似数据规模下提高微调模型基准表现。

provenance.notes: 配置声明agent_model=sonnet / actual_model=gpt-6.1-sol；无独立后端模型回执及会话标识，按模板置null；未探测模型。

sections_read: Appendix §7–11 including tables and prompt examples

evidence.quote: The refined dataset immediately feeds back into model training, creating a dynamic feedback loop where improved model capabilities inform subsequent optimization cycles.
evidence.support_explanation: 更新对象是SFT训练数据，收益由重新训练模型测量。

evidence.quote: For each iteration of Middo’s optimization, the base model is fine-tuned for one epoch on the dataset optimized in that specific iteration to mitigate the risk of overfitting to the data
evidence.support_explanation: 评估产物为微调权重，不是冻结执行器读取留存harness。
最近邻由本文讨论，未提供其独立全文。

reason: 冻结A3按被评价对象裁定：Middo保留重写训练数据并重新SFT，中心收益是任务模型权重改善，不是留存prompt/skill/tool/workflow/memory等harness组件在后续任务中的收益。
rationale: 三轴诊断与差异化数据重写可识别，但后续使用是SFT而非harness复用。按冻结A3排除，不以低分替代范围判定。
